inj.note: Mays was a full participant in all three practices during Week 7 prep. His 21-day practice window opened Oct. 7, and there's a chance that he's activated off injured reserve ahead of Sunday's NFC North tilt. Mays opened the regular season on injured reserve due to a fractured wrist that he suffered during the preseason.

news.h: Lions to get DB Brian Branch, C Cade Mays back vs. Packers
news.d: The Lions will have both Branch and center Cade Mays for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
